title: Specialized API Tools
summary: This module provides a collection of specialized tools for agents to interact with various external APIs and services, enabling capabilities like data querying, web automation, document processing, and integration with third-party platforms.

nodes.label: AIMindTool
nodes.title: AI-Minds Data Query
nodes.description: A tool that queries data from various sources (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) using AI-Minds, allowing natural language questions against structured data.

nodes.label: ApifyActorsTool
nodes.title: Apify Actor Runner
nodes.description: Runs Apify Actors to perform web scraping and data extraction tasks. Requires an Apify API token and uses the `langchain-apify` package.

nodes.label: ArxivPaperTool
nodes.title: Arxiv Paper Fetcher
nodes.description: Fetches metadata and optionally downloads PDF papers from Arxiv based on a search query. Handles API requests, parsing XML, and file saving.

nodes.label: BrightDataDatasetTool
nodes.title: Bright Data Dataset Scraper
nodes.description: Scrapes structured data from URLs using the Bright Data Dataset API. Supports various output formats and handles job triggering, polling, and result retrieval.

nodes.label: CodeDocsSearchTool
nodes.title: Code Docs Search
nodes.description: Performs semantic search within code documentation content from a specified URL. Extends `RagTool` for RAG capabilities.

nodes.label: ComposioTool
nodes.title: Composio Action Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps Composio actions, allowing agents to execute various third-party integrations. Dynamically generates tool schemas from Composio actions.

nodes.label: ContextualAICreateAgentTool
nodes.title: Contextual AI Agent Creator
nodes.description: Creates Contextual AI RAG agents by ingesting documents into a datastore. Manages datastore creation, document upload, and agent setup.

nodes.label: ContextualAIParseTool
nodes.title: Contextual AI Document Parser
nodes.description: Parses documents using Contextual AI's advanced parser, supporting various parse modes and output types. Handles job submission and status monitoring.

nodes.label: ContextualAIQueryTool
nodes.title: Contextual AI Agent Query
nodes.description: Queries Contextual AI RAG agents with natural language, retrieving responses based on the agent's knowledge base. Includes logic to wait for document processing.

nodes.label: DatabricksQueryTool
nodes.title: Databricks SQL Query
nodes.description: Executes SQL queries against Databricks workspace tables. Supports catalog/schema specification, result formatting, and includes robust error handling and DML protection.

nodes.label: DirectoryReadTool
nodes.title: Directory Content Lister
nodes.description: Recursively lists the contents (files) of a specified directory. Useful for agents needing to inspect local file structures.

nodes.label: FileCompressorTool
nodes.title: File/Directory Compressor
nodes.description: Compresses a file or directory into an archive (e.g., .zip, .tar.gz). Provides options for output path and overwriting existing archives.

nodes.label: FileReadTool
nodes.title: File Content Reader
nodes.description: Reads the content of a specified file, with optional parameters for reading specific lines or ranges. Handles file not found and permission errors.

nodes.label: GenerateCrewaiAutomationTool
nodes.title: CrewAI Automation Generator
nodes.description: Leverages CrewAI Studio to automatically generate CrewAI automations from natural language descriptions, translating requirements into functional implementations.

nodes.label: MergeAgentHandlerTool
nodes.title: Merge Agent Handler Tool
nodes.description: Wraps Merge Agent Handler tools, enabling CrewAI agents to securely access third-party integrations via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Manages authentication and tool execution.

nodes.label: MultiOnTool
nodes.title: MultiOn Web Browser Control
nodes.description: Provides LLMs with the ability to control web browsers using natural language instructions. Supports browsing, interaction, and session management.

nodes.label: NL2SQLTool
nodes.title: Natural Language to SQL
nodes.description: Converts natural language queries into SQL and executes them against a database. Includes schema introspection, query validation, and DML protection.

nodes.label: OCRTool
nodes.title: Optical Character Recognition
nodes.description: Performs OCR on images (local files or URLs) using an LLM's vision capabilities to extract text. Encodes local images to base64 for API submission.

nodes.label: StagehandTool
nodes.title: Stagehand Web Automation
nodes.description: Automates web browser interactions using natural language with atomic action handling. Supports navigation, clicking, form filling, data extraction, and element observation.

nodes.label: VisionTool
nodes.title: Image Analysis with Vision LLM
nodes.description: Analyzes images (local files or URLs) using vision models to describe their contents. Encodes local images to base64 for API submission.

nodes.label: ZapierActionTools
nodes.title: Zapier Action Tools Factory
nodes.description: A factory function that returns a list of Zapier action tools, enabling agents to interact with various Zapier integrations. Requires a Zapier API key.

nodes.label: AI-Minds API
nodes.title: AI-Minds Platform
nodes.description: External platform for querying data sources using natural language.

nodes.label: Apify Platform

nodes.description: External platform for running web scraping and data extraction actors.

nodes.description: External API for structured data scraping and dataset retrieval.

nodes.description: External API for integrating with various third-party services and applications.

nodes.label: Databricks SQL Warehouse
nodes.title: Databricks SQL Analytics
nodes.description: External Databricks service for executing SQL queries against data warehouses.

nodes.label: CrewAI Studio API
nodes.title: CrewAI Studio Automation Platform
nodes.description: External platform for generating and managing CrewAI automations.

nodes.label: Merge Agent Handler API
nodes.title: Merge Agent Handler Platform
nodes.description: External platform for secure access to third-party integrations via Model Context Protocol (MCP).

nodes.label: MultiOn API

nodes.description: External API for controlling web browsers using natural language instructions.

nodes.description: External service for advanced web browser automation and interaction.
